messages:
Maya (Engineering Manager): Heads up — Katie just submitted her resignation, last day 2026-05-12. Can we run through offboarding steps? Need benefits end date, COBRA timeline, laptop return, and access removal plan.
Katie Nguyen: Thanks Maya. Happy to help with handoff. My last commit is on the analytics exporter, I can doc it and leave runbook.
Kelly (People Ops): Sorry to hear youre leaving, Katie — well coordinate. Quick checklist Ill own: final paycheck timing, benefits end date, COBRA packet, exit interview. Sam/IT can you handle account decommission and laptop pickup?
Sam Ortiz (IT): Got it. Sam here — can confirm device return options (on-site dropoff or prepaid shipping). Ill start an asset ticket. For accounts: Okta deprovision at EOD of last day, GSuite and GitHub disabled same time, but Slack can be transferred to "inactive" role rather than deleted for 90 days. Any exceptions?
Katie Nguyen: Prefer prepaid shipping, Ill drop it at FedEx on 5/13 if that works. No special exceptions.
Jordan Lee (HR): For benefits: active through 05/31 per plan month cutoff. COBRA paperwork will be emailed within 14 days after termination paperwork is processed — expect an email from benefits@ with enrollment window. 401(k) options will be in separate notice from Finance.
Kelly (People Ops): Confirming final paycheck: regular pay date after termination will include unpaid vacation payout according to state law. Payroll will send confirmation by next Tue.
Sam Ortiz (IT): Drafting deactivation timeline:
```
- 2026-05-12 17:00 PT: mark as terminated in HRIS (People Ops)
- 2026-05-12 17:05 PT: Okta deprovision (Sam)
- 2026-05-12 17:10 PT: Google Workspace & GitHub access disabled (Sam)
- 2026-05-12 17:15 PT: VPN keys revoked, GCP service account tokens rotated (Infra)
- 2026-05-13: asset pickup/shipping complete (Sam)
```
If anyone needs earlier cutover for specific services (e.g., keys rotated before day end), say now.
Maya (Engineering Manager): Please do not cut off my CI deploy bot credentials until the handoff is complete — Ill coordinate with Katie to rotate tokens after she documents the exporter.
Sam Ortiz (IT): Noted — we can exclude the CI service account until you confirm token rotation. Add service account email(s) here.
Katie Nguyen: Service account is analytics-ci@redwood-inference.com. Ill rotate tokens on 5/12 at 10am PT and post in the thread when done.
Kelly (People Ops): Scheduling exit interview: Jordan, can you take the 30-min? Katie, what times work the week of 5/4?
Jordan Lee (HR): I have 5/6 2pm or 5/8 11am available. Katie?
Katie Nguyen: 5/6 2pm works. Put me on calendar.
Kelly (People Ops): COBRA note to include in offboarding email: employees have 60 days from notice to elect coverage. We send initial enrollment docs and summary of benefits. Let me know if there are dependents to include.
Katie Nguyen: Yes, spouse covered — will confirm dependent details via DM.
Maya (Engineering Manager): Handoff plan: Katie will create a short runbook PR and tag @team. I will do a canary handover review on 5/11.
Katie Nguyen: PR is in progress, will open by EOD 5/5.
Kelly (People Ops): Action items Im tracking: [final paycheck confirmation], [COBRA packet sent], [exit interview scheduled], [HRIS termination processed]. Sam: [asset ticket], [deprovision schedule]. Maya: [handoff review]. Katie: [PR + confirm shipping]. Ill follow up with calendar invites and the official offboarding email once weve filled any blanks. :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz (IT): Created asset ticket #IT-4127 for MacBook return and added prepaid label option.
Jordan Lee (HR): Calendar invite sent for 5/6 2pm exit interview.
Katie Nguyen: Thanks everyone — appreciate the support and will finish docs this week.
IT Bot: Reminder scheduled: deactivate-okta katie.nguyen at 2026-05-12T17:05:00Z (automated).
